result.topic_en: Calculations with the characteristic variables r = x-(u+a)t and s = x-(u-a)t for one-dimensional air waves, expressing dr and ds in terms of the differentials dp and dq of the Riemann invariants.
result.transcription:
$dq - 2at\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}(dp+dq) = d(x-(u-a)t)\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$ $(\delta x - (u-a)\delta t)$
$dp - 2at\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}(dp+dq) = d(x-(u+a)t)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$ $(\delta x - (u+a)\delta t)$
$dq$ [-$\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$-] $(\delta x-(u-a)\delta t) - 2at\,\delta q\,(dp+dq) = d(x-(u-a)t)\,\delta q$
$dp$ $\quad -2at\,\delta p\,(dp+dq) = d(x-(u+a)t)\,\delta p$

$(x-(u+a)t) = r$ $\quad (x-(u-a)t) = s$
[-$\frac{\partial}{\partial x}$ = ...-]
$dr = dx - (u+a)dt - t$ [-$da$-] $(dp+dq)$
$ds = dx - (u-a)dt - t$ [-$da$-] $2a(dp+dq)$
$= (1 - 2at\frac{\partial p}{\partial x})(dx-(u+a)dt) -$

$dr = dp\left(\frac{1}{\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}} - 2at\right) + (-2at)\,dq$
$ds = dp\,(-2at) + \left(\frac{1}{\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}} - 2at\right)dq$

[-$\Delta dp$-] $=$

methods.what: Relation between differentials of the Riemann invariant q and the characteristic variable x-(u-a)t
Relation between differentials of the Riemann invariant p and the characteristic variable x-(u+a)t
Introduction of characteristic coordinates r and s
Differential of r using dependence of u and a on p and q
Expression of dr and ds as linear combinations of dp and dq (Jacobian of change of variables (p,q) -> (r,s))
Expression of ds in terms of dp and dq
